title: Massive Groups of Volunteers Are Ready to Face Down ICE at the Polls
gist: Ahead of the 2026 US midterms, hundreds of coordinated grassroots and national groups (Indivisible, ACLU, Common Cause, 614 ICE Watch, NorCal Resist, LUCHA) have trained volunteers to patrol polling sites and document any ICE presence, using Signal/WhatsApp networks, private heat maps and Election Day war rooms. DHS says it is not targeting polling places but reserves 'targeted enforcement'; Trump officials have declined to rule out deployments, while some election experts say it won't happen at scale.

insights.claim: DHS says ICE is not planning operations targeting polling locations but explicitly reserves the right to make arrests near them through 'intelligence-driven targeted enforcement.'
insights.speaker: David Gilbert
insights.so_what: The carve-out leaves room for incidents near polls that could become flashpoints affecting turnout and election legitimacy narratives.
insights.quote: ICE conducts intelligence-driven targeted enforcement, and if an active public safety threat endangered a polling location, they may be arrested as a result of that targeted enforcement action.
